articles.summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust,” “IVT” or the “Company”) (NYSE: IVT) today announced that DJ Busch, President and Chief Executive Officer; Christy David, Chief Operating Officer, General Counsel and Secretary; and Dave Heimberger, Chief Investment Officer, will participate in an open roundtable discussion at the BofA Securities 2026 Global Real Estate Conference on Tuesday, September 15, 2026, at 11:05 a.m. Eastern Time. Event Details: Date: Tuesday, September 15, 2026 Time: 11:05 a.m. Eastern Time Live Webcast: Roundtable Webcast Link A replay of the webcast will be posted within 24 hours after the conclusion of the live event to the Company’s Investor Relations portion of the website at https://www.inventrustproperties.com/investor-relations/ . About InvenTrust Properties Corp. InvenTrust Properties Corp. articles.title: InvenTrust Properties to Present at BofA Securities 2026 Global Real Estate Conference
